name: Chimeric Sphere — 2/1 with flying, then "becomes a 3/2 Construct artifact creature and loses flying"
notes: Partial sweep (single cards, 2026-10-12). The second ability produced only a flying loss aimed at everything: "and loses flying" was left inside the text of what the Sphere becomes. Fired after the first ability, the Sphere is a 3/2 Construct artifact creature without flying.
